name: AI Tools Arena

sources.title: Homepage — live WordPress AI-tools blog/curated list site (KrakatoaDigital); no submit link anywhere
AI Tools List — category index page; no submission route, only a generic Contact Us form

requirements: No documented submission route — the site is an editorial blog with curated AI-tools posts, not a self-serve directory
Only contact paths: a footer 'Contact Us' form (name/email/message) and a 'YouTube Advertiser Inquiry Form'
preparation: Product name, URL, and a short pitch — everything must fit the generic contact form
A realistic ask: coverage in a blog post or category list, not a structured directory entry
workflow: Open https://aitoolsarena.com/ and use the Contact Us form (name, email, message)
Pitch the tool for inclusion in the AI Tools List or a relevant category post
No defined review process — outcome depends entirely on the editor
watchFor: This is an affiliate-content site ('I may receive commissions') — coverage decisions may be affiliate-driven
No self-serve listing, no pricing page for listings, no stated criteria
A paid 'YouTube Advertiser Inquiry Form' exists for video promotion — separate from directory listing
Duplicated navigation items suggest a lightly maintained WordPress template
countsAsLive: The tool is named in an aitoolsarena.com list/blog post with a link
unknowns: Whether the editor accepts unsolicited listing requests at all
Whether inclusion is free or paid
